BILLING.description: Financial inquiries, charges, fee disputes, refunds, payment method issues, invoice requests, and Prime subscription renewals.
hitl_triggers: Disputed charges requiring financial account lookup or debit reversal
Unauthorized credit card debits or potential payment fraud
Retroactive multi-month refund requests requiring manager approval
rag_safe_scenarios: Self-service instructions for managing Prime auto-renewal
Where to download printable PDF invoices or receipts
General payment method compatibility policies (credit cards, gift cards)
Standard bank authorization hold duration explanations

SHIPPING.description: Order delivery tracking, transit delays, delivery instructions, carrier performance, and missing/damaged packages.
hitl_triggers: Package marked 'Delivered' but missing after 24h search window (theft / lost parcel replacement)
Damaged merchandise requiring replacement authorization or inspection
Severe driver misconduct or property damage claims
Emergency expedited delivery failure for critical supplies/medication
rag_safe_scenarios: Self-service tracking links and carrier transit progress explanation
Standard residential delivery time windows (8 AM - 8 PM)
How to add apartment gate codes and delivery instructions
Amazon Hub Locker pickup rules and holding time limits

TECHNICAL.description: Hardware, firmware, app software, streaming video/music playback, device resets, and account security/access troubleshooting.
hitl_triggers: Account security lockout due to suspicious activity (account recovery needed)
Hardware battery failure, thermal events, or swollen lithium cells (safety emergency)
Physical screen fracture or hardware failure requiring warranty RMA replacement
Disappeared library of purchased digital content across years of purchases
rag_safe_scenarios: Standard factory reset procedures for Fire TV and Kindle
Force rebooting a frozen e-reader by holding power for 40 seconds
Common Prime Video playback error code guidance (5004, 7031)
Re-pairing Fire TV remote or reconnecting Echo to Wi-Fi

GENERAL_INQUIRY.description: Corporate policies, returns windows, warranties, trade-in programs, seller inquiries, and customer feedback.
hitl_triggers: Service of formal legal process, subpoenas, or litigation notices
Seller bribery / review manipulation reports requiring Trust & Safety action
Severe customer harassment or threats from third-party marketplace sellers
Personal injury / product liability claims caused by defective items
rag_safe_scenarios: Standard 30-day and extended holiday return window explanation
How to contact a third-party marketplace seller via 'Ask a question'
Amazon Hub / Whole Foods drop-off return procedures
Opting out of promotional email communications
